name: FGF2 expanded fresh-test protocol
known_at_freezing: Upstream file names, sizes and Git blob SHAs at the pinned commit (GitHub tree API).
Time grids (time_trunc.txt) of fgf_sp_5, fgf_sp_10 and fgf_sp_60, stimulation annotations and model XML.
Original-author B3 simulation exports, used only to infer the fgf_sp_60 timing.
Pilot results on the eight previously used conditions; the mixed 2.5/250 ng/ml test was already viewed.
No response value of any newly listed condition had been loaded or viewed.

excluded.fgf_NaClO3_250ng: Pharmacological HSGAG perturbation: a different receiver condition, outside this protocol.
excluded.fgf_sp_60_0-25ng: No single-cell export at the pinned commit (population mean only).

schedules.fgf_3_20: 3 min on every 23 min from 0, from the B3 XML.
schedules.fgf_sp_10: [0, 10) from the B3 XML sp_10 inputs.
schedules.fgf_sp_60: [0, 60) inferred: the authors' B3 simulations of sp_60 equal their sustained simulations until about 62 min, the same lag seen for sp_10 at about 12-16 min. No XML input exists at the pinned commit.
schedules.fgf_mixed: [1, 4), [24, 54), [114, 119) from pulses_trunc.txt and the B3 XML.

session_notes: Raw file names Ch01-Ch04_FGF__{250,25,2.5,0.25}_ngml_3_20_30_50_5_120_val.csv indicate that the four mixed concentrations were channels of one experiment, so the new mixed concentrations share a session with the viewed reference.
Independent experimental-day identifiers are unavailable for all conditions.

data_rules.hashes: Every downloaded file must match its upstream Git blob SHA; otherwise abort.
data_rules.time_grid: Use *_trunc.txt with the folder's time_trunc.txt; require uniform 2-min spacing, otherwise exclude the condition and report.
data_rules.nonfinite: Exclude any cell row containing a non-finite value and report the count per condition.
data_rules.means: Recompute population means from single cells and report the maximum difference to the author *_mean_trunc.txt (report only).
data_rules.normalization: For fgf_mixed 0.25 and 25 ng/ml, attempt the pilot's 10-30 min per-cell median reconstruction from *_unnormalized.txt and report the error; the analysis uses the author *_trunc.txt regardless.

features: Identical to the pilot: forecasting_rows() and model_features() in calibrate_fgf2.py, a 10-min observed warmup, and the future commanded waveform known to every predictor.
history_clock: causal_history features plus time_min and time2: the nested ablation against current_response_clock.
selection: Per model and horizon, the alpha minimizing condition-equal validation MSE; fit on train only; validation is never added to training.
metrics: Condition-equal RMSE per role, per-condition MSE, and a test time-support split at the maximum training forecast origin.

primary_hypotheses.H1: 10-min condition-equal RMSE on test_new_protocol: causal_history < current_response_clock.
primary_hypotheses.H2: 10-min condition-equal RMSE on test_new_protocol: history_clock < current_response_clock (nested ablation).

secondary: H1 and H2 on test_new_protocol_inferred_timing and on test_new_concentration_same_session.
The same comparisons at the 2-min horizon.
Number of test conditions in which causal_history beats current_response_clock and persistence.

robustness.leave_one_protocol_out: For each protocol in {fgf_sus, fgf_3_20, fgf_sp_5, fgf_sp_10, fgf_sp_60, fgf_mixed new concentrations}: train on all other listed protocols (all concentrations; viewed reference excluded), alpha fixed at the primary selection, and report the 10-min RMSE of persistence, current_response_clock, causal_history and history_clock.
robustness.sp_60_timing: Rescore test_new_protocol_inferred_timing with the onset shifted by -1 and +1 min (fgf_sp_60_onset-1, fgf_sp_60_onset+1) using the unchanged fitted models.

inference: No significance tests or confidence intervals: conditions are not independent replicates and experimental-day identifiers are unavailable.
reporting: All primary, secondary and robustness results are reported whatever their direction; the viewed reference is context only.
